description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, big number operations, and modular arithmetic, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication system. It includes prime testing, safe prime generation, and Montgomery multiplication implementations.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime modulus and generator based on specified key size.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic configuration entry with a composite safe prime structure based on specified key size.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Initializes a new configuration entry with empty modulus and generator.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file in base64-encoded format.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Performs a probabilistic primality test on a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of one BigInteger by another.

methods.name: BigIntegerLShift
methods.description: Performs a left shift on a BigInteger by a specified number of bits.
